Intro: "We reserve the right to refuse service". Huh.
Hard to say we really got any "rights" nowadays. Feels like nothing's free—but, you can always bribe a soldier to get away with whatever you want.
I wish I had a button like that, ha! One push, and some stranger gets taken by stone-faced guards who bruise your wrists when they drag you out. Trust me, I've encountered them plenty.

The Spoilage, the fear, the hunger…it breeds madness within people. We are happy to do what we're told as long as we get to eat. People eat up everything Svetka says if it means they can get food on the table.
The madness has rotted their senses. We're animals in filthy pens, waiting, listening to the grinding of the blades while praising the butcher. Might as well die trying to crawl out…
I'm sure you've seen them already. People with maggots crawling from their ears and eyes, writhing on the streets, rotting away.
Hey. Word to the wise. You can't send away all your "problems" with a press of a button.
